name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.vecOf_mem
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (hv : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.Valid g)
  (K : Finset.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Tm (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))),
  Membership.mem.{0, 0}
    (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.allLists 2
      (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.vecOf g hv K)

source.code:
theorem vecOf_mem (K : Finset (g.base.Tm)) : g.vecOf hv K ∈ allLists 2 g.base.nodes.length := by
  rw [mem_allLists]
  refine ⟨by simp [vecOf], ?_⟩
  intro v hv'
  simp only [vecOf, List.mem_map] at hv'
  obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := hv'
  split_ifs <;> omega
